owners.when: /deck/:deckId in slide, grid or book mode
the source drawer is open; delegates to the editor

deck.info.label: Deck info
deck.info.doc: Title, theme, sections with slide ids and titles, counts (the canvas slides, charts and guides included) and the current revision.

deck.create.label: New deck
deck.create.doc: Creates a deck under decks/ from a template of the index (template.list), the GT brand template or one title slide, and returns its id, revision and counts.

deck.rename.label: Rename deck
deck.rename.doc: Sets the deck title, the name the sidebar head, the toolbar and the deck list show; one deck.set of /title.

deck.set.label: Set a deck field
deck.set.doc: Writes one field of the deck manifest by JSON pointer (/title, /theme, /defaults/appearance, /defaults/counter, /defaults/notes) as one deck.set mutation, the write the Themes panel and Slide numbers make; an absent value removes the field.

deck.list.label: List decks
deck.list.doc: The manifest facts of every deck under decks/ (id, title, slide and section counts, revision, the stamps), newest first; decks in the trash are left out unless asked.

deck.copy.label: Make a copy
deck.copy.doc: Copies a deck under a new id with a new title, every slide or the named ones, with or without the speaker notes, at revision 0 with an empty version log; the output names the new deck.

deck.trash.label: Move to trash
deck.trash.doc: Moves a deck to the trash by writing trashedAt on its manifest: the home page, the fresh presentation route and deck.list leave it out until deck.restore clears the stamp or deck.remove deletes it; nothing else changes.

deck.restore.label: Restore from trash
deck.restore.doc: Clears trashedAt on a deck in the trash, so the home page and deck.list show it again.

deck.remove.label: Delete forever
deck.remove.doc: Deletes a deck: the folder under decks/ or the prefix in the Blob store, with its slides, assets and version log. Irreversible; the Trash page calls it, and `confirm` must be true.

deck.setBackground.label: Set theme background
deck.setBackground.doc: Writes the background colour every slide without its own takes, what Add to theme writes; null removes it.

deck.guides.label: Set guides
deck.guides.doc: Adds, removes, moves, sets or clears the deck’s guide lines, sheet pixels the same on every slide; the result is sorted and inside the sheet, and an empty result removes the field.

template.list.label: Templates
template.list.doc: The template index: every template with its name, category, cover, sentence, slide count, theme and appearance, the organisation flag of a template saved on this deployment and its brand kit, plus the id of the template new presentations start from.

template.slides.label: Template slides
template.slides.doc: The slides of one template in order with their titles and kinds, the rows the gallery and Import slides read.

template.create.label: Save as template
template.create.doc: Saves a deck as a template of this deployment: decks/templates/<slug of the name> with the deck manifest, its slides, its assets and its brand kit, listed under Your organisation in the gallery; a name an organisation template already carries replaces that template and keeps its slug (the dialog says so first).

template.update.label: Replace a template
template.update.doc: Replaces the slides, assets and brand kit of an organisation template from a deck and keeps its id, name and sentence; the templates Turboslide ships are refused.

template.rename.label: Rename a template
template.rename.doc: Renames an organisation template; its id and its folder stay, so every link and every default record still name it. The templates Turboslide ships are refused.

template.delete.label: Delete a template
template.delete.doc: Deletes an organisation template folder and its index row; presentations made from it are not changed. The template new presentations start from is refused until another is chosen, and so are the templates Turboslide ships. Irreversible; `confirm` must be true.

template.setDefault.label: Use for new presentations
template.setDefault.doc: Makes a template the one /new and the Blank card start from on this deployment (decks/templates/default.json), whose name, logo and appearance every Reset and every default logo read; `blank` restores the blank deck Turboslide ships. An agent token needs the admin scope.

slide.list.label: List slides
slide.list.doc: Every slide in deck order with its number, section, title, kind and lint counts.

slide.get.label: Get slide
slide.get.doc: The normalized slide, the assets it references and its last render record.

slide.insert.label: Insert slide
slide.insert.doc: Inserts a slide into a section after the named slide, or first.

slide.remove.label: Remove slide
slide.remove.doc: Removes a slide from the deck and its section.

slide.move.label: Move slide
slide.move.doc: Moves a slide to a section after the named slide, or first.

slide.update.label: Patch slide
slide.update.doc: Applies a mutation list to one slide and returns the normalized slide with its findings.

slide.replace.label: Replace slide
slide.replace.doc: Replaces a slide with the given document; what the source drawer’s Apply emits.

slide.setLayout.label: Set layout
slide.setLayout.doc: Moves a content slide to another layout and refiles its blocks: to freeform the slide converts to the canvas, every block getting the position box it is drawn at (measured, gslides-parity SPEC-2 1.6); from freeform the boxes are dropped and the blocks fall into the target slots by geometry (docs/freeform.md).

slide.new.label: New slide
slide.new.doc: Inserts one slide made from a layout with empty placeholders after the named slide (or first in the section), as one slide.insert with template set; a Section header starts a new section that takes the slides after the anchor.

slide.duplicate.label: Duplicate slide
slide.duplicate.doc: Copies the named slides with fresh ids after the last of them, in one write; a copied section header starts a new section.

slide.skip.label: Skip slide
slide.skip.doc: Sets or clears skip on the named slides in one write: a skipped slide is left out of the slideshow, the shared view, the downloads and the print unless asked.

slide.applyLayout.label: Apply layout
slide.applyLayout.doc: Applies a layout to the named slides in one write, one slide.replace per slide: the title, the body, the lists, the tables and the pictures move into the matching placeholders and the rest is appended; only a Title slide or a Main point drops what does not fit, and the output names the dropped blocks.

slide.import.label: Import slides
slide.import.doc: Copies slides from another deck after the named slide in one write: the assets they use are copied into this deck, colliding slide ids are renamed, and the output lists the slides and the assets that came over.

slide.toCanvas.label: Arrange by hand
slide.toCanvas.doc: Converts slides to the canvas, the freeform layout, every object taking the position box it is drawn at (measured on a rendered sheet); a slide already on the freeform layout is left as it is; one write, one browser page for the call.

slide.setBackground.label: Change background
slide.setBackground.doc: Writes the background colour of slides in one write; null removes it and the theme default applies. A background picture is a picture object at the bottom of the stack.

text.replaceAll.label: Find and replace
text.replaceAll.doc: Replaces every occurrence of a string in the visible text of the deck (every Text of every block, the title slide fields, the table cells and the speaker notes) in one write, case insensitive unless asked; the output counts the replacements.

block.set.label: Set block property
block.set.doc: Writes one property of a block by JSON pointer; an absent value deletes it.

block.insert.label: Insert block
block.insert.doc: Inserts a block into a slot after the named block, or first; a block carrying pos on a slide that is not a canvas yet converts the slide first and lands as an object (gslides-parity SPEC-2 1.6).

block.remove.label: Remove block
block.remove.doc: Removes a block from its slide.

block.move.label: Move block
block.move.doc: Moves a block to a slot after the named block, or first.

block.align.label: Align blocks
block.align.doc: Aligns objects on one edge, against the selection for several, the slide for one, or the content box; against the selection the shared edge is the extreme object's own edge unless snap is true, and the slide's and the content box's edges stay exact; a slide that is not a canvas yet converts first (gslides-parity SPEC-2 0.80, 1.6; docs/FOCUS.md rank 14).

block.distribute.label: Distribute blocks
block.distribute.doc: Spreads freeform blocks along one axis with equal gaps between the first and the last, or with a fixed gap; with snap the moved edges round to the 8 px grid.

block.order.label: Order block
block.order.doc: Moves a freeform block through the stacking order, to the front or back or by one step, or to a given z rank, and renumbers the stack densely.

block.duplicate.label: Duplicate block
block.duplicate.doc: Copies the named blocks of a slide with fresh ids, each after its original; a positioned copy sits 16 px right and down and on top of the stack, a copied group takes a fresh tag and copied connectors keep their attachments to copied targets (gslides-parity SPEC-2 section 3).

block.group.label: Group
block.group.doc: Writes one group tag on two or more objects of a slide in one write; the tag is generated when none is given; a slide that is not a canvas yet converts first.

block.ungroup.label: Ungroup
block.ungroup.doc: Removes the group tag from the named objects, or from every member of a named group, in one write.

block.regroup.label: Regroup
block.regroup.doc: Writes a tag back on the named objects, the set the editor remembers from the last ungroup.

block.rotate.label: Rotate
block.rotate.doc: Rotates objects to an angle or by an angle, degrees clockwise normalized to 0 up to 360, about each box or about the selection (a group rotation moves the members around the union centre); attached connectors follow; a slide that is not a canvas yet converts first.

block.flip.label: Flip
block.flip.doc: Toggles one flip axis on objects; about the selection every member also mirrors about the union centre and its angle becomes 360 minus itself (a group flip); attached connectors follow.

block.crop.label: Crop image
block.crop.doc: Writes the crop of a picture as fractions of it trimmed from each side; a slide that is not a canvas yet converts first when the picture is positioned.

block.mask.label: Mask image
block.mask.doc: Clips a picture to a closed shape preset, or removes the mask with null.

block.resetImage.label: Reset image
block.resetImage.doc: Removes the crop, the mask, the adjustments and the round one crop anchor and aspect of a picture in one write.

block.adjust.label: Adjustments
block.adjust.doc: Writes a picture’s transparency (0 to 1), brightness and contrast (-1 to 1); null clears one.

block.setAlt.label: Alt text
block.setAlt.doc: Writes the description of an object: on the block for a shape, chart, line or text box, on the asset for a block that shows a picture, so two pictures of one asset share one description; the output names where it went.

block.shadow.label: Drop shadow
block.shadow.doc: Writes or removes the drop shadow of objects: colour, opacity, angle, distance and blur, the absent ones at Google’s defaults.

block.autofit.label: Text fitting
block.autofit.doc: Writes the fitting mode of a text carrying block: Do not autofit, Shrink text on overflow or Resize shape to fit text (grow, positioned blocks only); with apply the fit is measured and written in the same write, and the output names the fields written.

text.style.label: Text style
text.style.doc: Marks a range of a Text italic, underlined, struck, superscript or subscript, or gives it a text or highlight colour (true sets, false clears, null clears a colour), as one text.replace of the whole Text; the output returns the new markup.

text.list.label: List options
text.list.doc: Writes the marker, the preset and the items’ levels of a list block (a paragraph or text box converts to a list first); levels run 1 to 9.

text.spacing.label: Line and paragraph spacing
text.spacing.doc: Writes the line spacing (a factor) and the space before and after paragraphs (px) of text blocks; null clears one.

text.columns.label: Columns
text.columns.doc: Writes the column count of text blocks, 1 to 3.

text.indent.label: Indent
text.indent.doc: Steps the left indent of text blocks by 64 px in or out, or writes it; on a list block with items the items’ levels step instead.

text.case.label: Capitalization
text.case.doc: Rewrites the characters of a range in lowercase, UPPERCASE or Title Case, marks and links kept, as one text.replace.

text.insert.label: Insert text
text.insert.doc: Inserts a string at a plain text offset of a Text, the special characters picker’s write, as one text.replace at [at, at].

chart.setData.label: Edit chart data
chart.setData.doc: Writes a chart’s categories and series in one write; every series carries one value per category.

chart.setKind.label: Chart type
chart.setKind.doc: Writes a chart’s kind; a pie keeps the first series and the output names the dropped ones.

table.merge.label: Merge cells
table.merge.doc: Merges the cells from one corner to another into the anchor; the covered cells’ texts join the anchor’s with a line break.

table.unmerge.label: Unmerge cells
table.unmerge.doc: Removes the merge that covers a cell.

table.insertRows.label: Insert rows
table.insertRows.doc: Inserts rows above or below a row, merges and cell styles shifted, in one write.

table.insertColumns.label: Insert columns
table.insertColumns.doc: Inserts columns left or right of a column, every row gaining empty cells, merges and cell styles shifted, in one write.

table.deleteRows.label: Delete rows
table.deleteRows.doc: Deletes the rows from one index to another; deleting every row removes the table.

table.deleteColumns.label: Delete columns
table.deleteColumns.doc: Deletes the columns from one index to another; deleting every column removes the table.

table.distribute.label: Distribute rows or columns
table.distribute.doc: Gives every row an equal height or every column an equal width from a total; without a total the widths or heights clear so the content sizes them.

table.cellStyle.label: Cell fill and border
table.cellStyle.doc: Writes the fill and the border of cells in one write; null clears one; a border weight of 0 is Google’s Transparent border.

shape.set.label: Shape
shape.set.doc: Writes the shape fields of shape blocks in one write: the preset, its adjust values, fill, border colour, weight, dash and corner radius; null clears one.

line.set.label: Line
line.set.doc: Writes the line fields of line blocks in one write: the kind, the start and end decorations, weight, dash, bend and points; a connect end attaches to a shape’s connection site and moves the end onto it, null detaches.

diagram.insert.label: Insert diagram
diagram.insert.doc: Inserts a diagram template as one group of shape, text and line objects, centred on the sheet unless a box is given; a slide that is not a canvas yet converts first; the output names the ids.

section.set.label: Set sections
section.set.doc: Replaces the section list, the only place slide order lives.

slide.lease.label: Lease slide
slide.lease.doc: Takes a lease on a slide for the author; another author’s write is rejected with 409 unless forced.

asset.add.label: Add asset
asset.add.doc: Adds a file, a data URL or a fetched URL as an asset with its role, alt, license fields and optional two-tone treatment; returns the asset with twins and metrics.

asset.dither.label: Dither asset
asset.dither.doc: Re-runs the two-tone pipeline on an asset with new parameters and reports plate clearance; with fromRecorded it reads the committed twins back and verifies them cell for cell.

material.capture.label: Capture material
material.capture.doc: Renders a shader material at 3200 by 1800 and captures frozen frames at the given anchors as assets with recipe keys, through the two-tone screen when asked; one anchor returns the asset, several the list.

material.list.label: List materials
material.list.doc: The material catalog: every paper:* entry with its uniform schema and palette presets, and the proto:* engines with their availability.

render.slide.label: Render
render.slide.doc: Renders slides in one or both themes at 1x or 2x and returns render records with image paths.

render.sheet.label: Contact sheet
render.sheet.doc: Renders a contact sheet per theme with a JSON cell map from cell boxes to slide ids.

lint.run.label: Lint
lint.run.doc: Runs the grammar linter on slides in the static, rendered or both layers and returns findings.

fix.run.label: Fix
fix.run.doc: Applies the fix mutations of findings that carry one and reports what remains.

diff.run.label: Diff
diff.run.doc: The mutation list between two revisions in prose, optionally with before and after crops.

version.save.label: Save version
version.save.doc: Saves a named version at the current revision.

version.list.label: List versions
version.list.doc: The saved versions with author, note and revision.

version.restore.label: Restore version
version.restore.doc: Restores a version as a mutation, so it is undoable and visible in History.

view.goto.label: Go to slide
view.goto.doc: Shows a slide in the viewer, the editor or the presenter.

view.mode.label: View mode
view.mode.doc: Switches between slide, grid and book mode.

view.theme.label: View theme
view.theme.doc: Sets the theme of chrome and sheet together through the gt-theme key.

view.zoom.label: Zoom
view.zoom.doc: Sets the stage scale in the editor, a factor of the sheet size from 0.25 to 16 or fit, keeping a named sheet point under the stage centre; the output reports the effective zoom and the scroll; a view action with no document field.

export.run.label: Export
export.run.doc: Exports the deck to PPTX in flatten (perfect, pixel identical) or native (editable text) mode and returns the verified report.

export.text.label: Download as plain text
export.text.doc: The deck as plain text: one block of paragraphs per slide in order, table cells joined by tabs, a blank line between slides, the notes after each slide when asked; skipped slides left out unless asked.

build.run.label: Build standalone
build.run.doc: Writes the single-file HTML deck with fonts and assets inlined and asserts the size budget.

validate.run.label: Validate
validate.run.doc: Validates a deck directory and returns the issues and the normalized document.

source.read.label: Read source
source.read.doc: Glyphfield standard action: the exact current source document of the active owner.

source.apply.label: Apply source
source.apply.doc: Glyphfield standard action: applies a JSON string or object through the active owner’s validator.

controls.list.label: List controls
controls.list.doc: Glyphfield standard action: the visible interactive controls with labels, data-control ids and values.

control.activate.label: Activate control
control.activate.doc: Glyphfield standard action: activates a control by accessible label or data-control id.

control.set.label: Set control
control.set.doc: Glyphfield standard action: sets a form control by accessible label or data-control id.

artifact.download.label: Download artifact
artifact.download.doc: Glyphfield standard action: saves a returned artifact with its deterministic file name.

deck.tailor.label: Tailor for a customer
deck.tailor.doc: The tailoring pass as one write: replaces the customer name in every visible text and the notes, swaps the pictures whose alt text names the old customer for one asset, and skips the named slides; answers the counts per step and the slides that changed.

assist.propose.label: Ask the assistant
assist.propose.doc: Asks the assistant for a proposal over the named slides: a shorter rewrite or speaker notes, or a free ask that resolves to one of the two; answers signed cards a caller accepts with assist.accept. A read: nothing is written until a card is accepted.

assist.accept.label: Accept a proposal
assist.accept.doc: Writes one card assist.propose returned, as one write by the assistant: the signature, the expiry and the deck are verified, a card behind the deck is re based when its blocks are unchanged and refused otherwise.

brand.get.label: Brand kit
brand.get.doc: The brand kit record of the deck: the colour roles, the faces, the logo and footer slots, the slide numbers, the frame toggles and the words that never translate; an empty object for a deck that reads the deployment’s default kit.

brand.set.label: Set a brand kit field
brand.set.doc: Writes one value of the brand kit by JSON pointer (/colors/light/primary, /fonts/display, /mark, /footer/logo, /footer/text, /counter/format, /frame/rails, /positions/mark, /lexicon, /appearance, /name) as one deck.set mutation under /brand, the write every Brand kit panel control makes; an absent value removes the field. The record is validated before the commit.

brand.reset.label: Reset the brand kit
brand.reset.doc: Removes the brand kit record, so the deck reads the deployment’s default kit, or one field of it when a pointer is given; a deck with nothing to remove writes no revision.

font.list.label: Fonts
font.list.doc: The font catalog: every face with the name PowerPoint and Google Slides use, its category, weights, italic and licence (gslides-parity SPEC-5-amendments A5; docs/PRODUCT.md 4.2).

presence.list.label: Collaborators
presence.list.doc: The roster of the deck’s room with the computed mark, slide, selection, pointer and follow target per participant; server side on the window transport.

presence.follow.label: Follow
presence.follow.doc: The attached page follows a client’s slide and scroll; refused for viewers, commenters, anonymous people and agents with Go to slide offered instead.

presence.pointer.label: Live pointer
presence.pointer.doc: Turns the caller’s live pointer on or off, persisted on the principal record per deck.

sync.status.label: Sync status
sync.status.doc: The client’s position in the room: the last stream entry, the revision, the pending and retained counts, the tier, the transport and whether the stream is connected.

deck.watch.label: Watch
deck.watch.doc: Long polls for the checkpoints and comment entries since a revision, the polling form for a transport without a stream; answers at once when something is newer, else at the timeout.

comment.add.label: Comment
comment.add.doc: Starts a thread at an anchor (the deck, a slide, a block, a text range, a table cell or the notes) with a plain text body whose {@n} tokens name its mentions, optionally assigned; server side.

comment.reply.label: Reply
comment.reply.doc: Appends a reply to a thread; server side.

comment.edit.label: Edit comment
comment.edit.doc: Rewrites a comment’s body, its author only; 409 with the current thread when the thread moved since expectedUpdatedAt.

comment.delete.label: Delete comment
comment.delete.doc: Tombstones a comment, keeping its replies; the first comment’s tombstone keeps the thread; restore brings it back within 30 days.

comment.resolve.label: Resolve
comment.resolve.doc: Marks a thread resolved; last writer wins.

comment.reopen.label: Re-open
comment.reopen.doc: Reopens a resolved thread; last writer wins.

comment.assign.label: Assign
comment.assign.doc: Assigns a thread to a principal or an invitation (an agent principal is assignable), or clears the assignment with null; last writer wins.

comment.done.label: Mark as done
comment.done.doc: The assignee marks the thread done; last writer wins.

comment.react.label: React
comment.react.doc: Toggles the caller’s reaction on a comment from the 24 emoji palette; reactions are a set per emoji keyed by principal.

comment.list.label: Comments
comment.list.doc: The threads of the deck or a slide with their anchors resolved against the current document, filtered by block, state, assignment to the caller, author, search text or revision; 403 without readComments.

comment.get.label: Comment thread
comment.get.doc: One thread with its anchor resolved against the current document.

comment.link.label: Link to comment
comment.link.doc: The editor and the view URLs that open the deck on the thread’s slide with its card expanded; runs in the page on the window transport.

notification.list.label: Notifications
notification.list.doc: The caller’s inbox, newest first: mentions, replies, assignments, resolutions, reactions, access requests and grants, coalesced per thread inside a 15 minute window.

notification.markRead.label: Mark as read
notification.markRead.doc: Marks the named notifications read, or every one; answers the unread count.

notification.settings.label: Notification settings
notification.settings.doc: Reads or writes the caller’s per deck level (All comments, Comments for you, None), the email switch and, for the owner, whether commenters read the Activity panel; a read when every field is absent.

activity.list.label: Activity
activity.list.doc: The merged activity feed of the deck: version windows, comment events, share events, requests, role changes, renames, restores, named versions, exports, imports and trash; editors and the owner, commenters when allowed.

version.diff.label: Show changes
version.diff.doc: The mutations between two revisions grouped by touched block and by author, the data behind Show changes; from omitted with staged is the last named version, to defaults to the current revision.

share.get.label: Sharing
share.get.doc: The access record with its tokens hashed and the dead links of the last thirty days, plus the caller’s role, how it was reached and the capabilities it gives; a viewer receives the owner, the general access mode, their own grant and their capabilities only.

share.setGeneralAccess.label: General access
share.setGeneralAccess.doc: Sets Restricted or Anyone with the link with its role; the link mode mints a token and answers its /s/ URL once.

share.createLink.label: Create link
share.createLink.doc: Mints a share link with a role, a label and an optional expiry and answers its /s/ URL once; several links with several roles may live at once.

share.revokeLink.label: Revoke link
share.revokeLink.doc: Revokes one link; every session grant that names it dies on its next request.

share.rotateLink.label: Rotate link
share.rotateLink.doc: Mints a new token for a link and answers its URL once; the old token dies.

share.stop.label: Stop sharing
share.stop.doc: Sets Restricted and revokes every link.

share.invite.label: Share with people
share.invite.doc: Writes one grant per address with a role and an optional message and sends the invitations unless told not to; never says whether an account exists, and answers sent, queued or no-mail per address with the deck link for hand delivery.

share.setRole.label: Change role
share.setRole.doc: Changes a grant’s role; the owner’s row is refused.

share.remove.label: Remove access
share.remove.doc: Removes a grant; the caller may remove their own at any role.

share.setExpiry.label: Access expiry
share.setExpiry.doc: Sets or clears a grant’s expiry, up to one year ahead.

share.settings.label: Sharing settings
share.settings.doc: The gear’s five switches: editors can share, viewers can download, viewers can see comments, show names to people with the link, allow embedded HTML blocks; owner only, with a re-authentication within 10 minutes on the window transport.

share.requestAccess.label: Request access
share.requestAccess.doc: Asks the owner for a role with an optional message; always answers the same sentence, so a caller learns nothing about whether the deck exists; rate limited per IP, and an anonymous caller must give an email.

share.listRequests.label: Access requests
share.listRequests.doc: The pending requests with the requester’s label, email, role, message and time.

share.respond.label: Respond to request
share.respond.doc: Approves a request as a role or declines it with null; the requester is told when asked.

share.transferOwnership.label: Transfer ownership
share.transferOwnership.doc: Offers the deck to a signed in principal or an email, who accepts or declines; owner only, anonymous targets refused.

share.acceptOwnership.label: Accept ownership
share.acceptOwnership.doc: The pending owner takes the deck; the previous owner becomes an editor.

share.declineOwnership.label: Decline ownership
share.declineOwnership.doc: The pending owner declines the offer.

share.claim.label: Claim
share.claim.doc: A signed in principal claims an unowned deck (an admin any unowned deck); the deck then reads Anyone with the address can view, so every view link and the embed keep working while editing by address stops.

share.emailCollaborators.label: Email collaborators
share.emailCollaborators.doc: Sends a message to every collaborator or the named ones; declared this round and answers not implemented until round four.

deck.publish.label: Publish to the web
deck.publish.doc: Mints the published player’s token and answers the player and embed URLs once; every edit is published, and the player never opens the editor.

deck.unpublish.label: Stop publishing
deck.unpublish.doc: Revokes the published token; the player and the embed answer 410.

account.decks.label: My presentations
account.decks.doc: The caller’s deck index with the owner and the caller’s role per row: owned, shared with me, recent, trash, or all for an admin; on a checkout every deck as owned.

account.tokens.create.label: Create API key
account.tokens.create.doc: Mints an API key owned by the caller with a name, scopes and an optional expiry, shown once; never over MCP, and refused on a checkout, which has no accounts.

account.tokens.list.label: API keys
account.tokens.list.doc: The caller’s API keys without their secrets.

account.tokens.revoke.label: Revoke API key
account.tokens.revoke.doc: Revokes one of the caller’s keys; its MCP sessions close.

account.me.label: Account
account.me.doc: The caller’s principal, trust state, label, mark, avatar choice and sessions; the CLI can write the mark as a PNG.

account.setName.label: Change name
account.setName.doc: Sets the display name under the rules of SPEC-3 0.19 (NFC, 1 to 40 code points with a letter or digit, no bidi controls, the reserved and confusable lists, unique per deck by skeleton); the refusal sentences are fixed.

account.setAvatar.label: Change avatar
account.setAvatar.doc: Chooses the mark: initials, a glyph field, a dither plate, or a picture for signed in principals only.

account.sessions.label: Sessions
account.sessions.doc: The caller’s sign in sessions, the current one marked.

account.signOut.label: Sign out
account.signOut.doc: Ends one sign in session, or every other one with all.

account.forget.label: Forget this browser
account.forget.doc: Replaces the anonymous cookie with a fresh id and clears the browser’s mirrors; window only.

admin.assignOwner.label: Assign owner
admin.assignOwner.doc: An admin sets a deck’s owner.

admin.flag.label: Kill switch
admin.flag.doc: Reads or flips one of the kill switches (realtime, presence, comments, invites, email, exports, uploads, renderThumbs, materialize, htmlBlocks, signup, readOnly), read within 5 s by every instance.

picture.dither.label: Dither
picture.dither.doc: Writes the deck’s two tone screen over a picture’s continuous source as a non destructive field, or removes it with null; a slide that is not a canvas converts first when the picture is positioned; answers the variant key, the metrics and any warnings.

picture.materialize.label: Materialize dithers
picture.materialize.doc: Writes the variant files and records of every dithered picture on the named slides, prunes the variants no picture references when asked, or names the missing variants without writing under dryRun; server side.

slide.setBackgroundPicture.label: Background picture
slide.setBackgroundPicture.doc: One write for a covering picture object at the back of each named slide with an optional dither, replacing the covering picture already there unless told not to; the file, url and upload forms run asset.add server side first.

slide.setBackgroundMaterial.label: Background material
slide.setBackgroundMaterial.doc: Captures a shader material at an anchor and places the frozen frame as a covering picture object at the back of each named slide with an optional dither, in one call; server side.

methods.name: describe()
methods.description: The active owner, its actions and whether source read and apply are supported

methods.name: controls()
methods.description: Visible interactive controls with accessible labels, data-control ids and values

methods.name: activate(label)
methods.description: Activates a control by accessible label or data-control id; RangeError when missing

methods.name: set(label, value)
methods.description: Sets a control by label or data-control id and dispatches input and change

methods.name: readSource()
methods.description: The exact current source document of the active owner

methods.name: applySource(doc)
methods.description: Applies a JSON string or object through the validator, then waits two animation frames

methods.name: invoke(action, input)
methods.description: Runs a standard action or delegates to the active owner

methods.name: download(artifact)
methods.description: Saves a returned artifact with its deterministic file name

errors.name: TypeError
errors.when: malformed input, with the Zod path

errors.name: RangeError
errors.when: an unknown action, label or id

errors.name: ConflictError
errors.when: a stale baseRevision or a held lease, with the holder and the current document attached

errors.name: NotImplementedError
errors.when: an action declared in the table whose implementation lands in a later milestone
